description: This Java class 'SQLProcessor' provides utility functions for database access, including connection management, executing queries and updates, handling transactions, and setting prepared statement parameters within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SQLProcessor
classes.description: A utility class for managing database connections, executing SQL statements, handling transactions, and setting parameters for prepared statements within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction if manual transaction mode is enabled.

methods.name: rollback
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction if manual transaction mode is enabled, or marks the transaction for rollback.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes database resources such as ResultSet, PreparedStatement, and Connection, and commits if in manual transaction mode.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Establishes and returns a database connection, setting auto-commit to false if possible, and checking transaction status.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement with optional result set type, concurrency, fetch size, and max rows.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes the prepared statement as a query and returns the ResultSet.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Prepares and executes an SQL query string, returning the ResultSet.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes the prepared statement as an update and returns the number of affected rows.

methods.name: executeUpdate
methods.description: Executes an SQL update statement directly.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Advances the cursor in the current ResultSet.

methods.name: execQuery
methods.description: Executes an SQL query and processes each row with a callback function.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the prepared statement using a JdbcValueHandler.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a String parameter in the prepared statement.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Timestamp parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Time parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Date parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets an Integer parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Long parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Float parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Double parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a BigDecimal parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Boolean parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets an Object parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Blob parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a Clob parameter.

methods.name: setBinaryStream
methods.description: Serializes an object and writes it as a binary stream to a parameter.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets a byte array as a parameter.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Tests the connection by tracking connection strings if testing is enabled.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for a statement, considering the connection type and datasource defaults.

methods.name: checkLockWaitInfo
methods.description: Checks SQLException messages for lock wait timeout errors and logs detailed info.
